title: Scoring Table Lookup
description: Practice answering the riichi mahjong score for dealer or non-dealer, tsumo or ron, han and fu
koTsumoScore: Score (from each non-dealer / from the dealer)
questionLabel: Answer the score for these conditions

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get questions like this.

ko_mangan_plus.label: Non-dealer, mangan+
ko_mangan_plus.hint: Look up non-dealer scores at the five limit levels, from mangan to yakuman

oya_mangan_plus.label: Dealer, mangan+
oya_mangan_plus.hint: Look up dealer scores at the five limit levels, from mangan to yakuman

ko_non_mangan.label: Non-dealer, below mangan
ko_non_mangan.hint: Look up the non-dealer scoring table for 20 to 60 fu × 1 to 3 han

oya_non_mangan.label: Dealer, below mangan
oya_non_mangan.hint: Look up the dealer scoring table for 20 to 60 fu × 1 to 3 han

all.label: All
all.hint: The whole table: dealer and non-dealer, mangan and above included
